headlines.title: A 23-year-old turned a $50 Facebook Marketplace find into a $150,000 viral product — with no degree and no plan
headlines.summary: Oskar Flodstrom moved to L.A. with $400, was living on $1,000 a month and using food stamps — until a $50 piece with materials from Facebook Marketplace became a $225 viral product.

headlines.title: Costco Wholesale (COST) Could Be 16% Below Fair Value On DoorDash Delivery Rollout
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) has just taken its DoorDash partnership nationwide, putting same day delivery from every U.S. warehouse a tap away. That shift gives investors a fresh lens on this membership driven retailer. Against this rollout, Costco Wholesale’s 1-day share price return of 0.59% and 7-day gain of 1.23% sit alongside a 30-day share price decline of 6.87%, while the 1-year total shareholder return is down 3.

headlines.title: Doordash Just Dropped 16% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell or Load Up?
headlines.summary: A 16% slide in a month puts DoorDash stock in awkward territory, and the culprit is something far newer and more unsettling than a weak consumer or a rate scare. The case for buying the dip and the case for cutting losses both hinge on a single question about where DoorDash's real value actually lives.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
